statement: A finding-template rewrite and its derivation must be gated by two separate facts: rubric generation and the provenance of the inventory actually examined. In the derivation-emission branch, collapsing old-rubric output and current-rubric directory fallbacks into one legacy state gave bounded walks wording that claimed a complete tracked inventory. Preserve historical-rubric templates, emit tracked-inventory wording and derivations only for a successful tracked scan, and give current-rubric fallbacks distinct bounded-directory-walk wording with no derivation when the schema cannot truthfully represent that scope. Test historical-rubric, tracked-inventory, and Git-unavailable/failing paths separately.
quarantineReason: This staging record accompanies the derivation-emission branch, whose eventual squash commit does not yet exist on Cejel origin/main. It must not anchor to its own branch.
moveCondition: After the derivation-emission PR merges, identify its 40-character squash commit on Cejel origin/main and verify that its diff keeps rubric generation and inventory provenance separate, emits inventory-scan derivations only for successful tracked inventories, preserves historical wording, gives directory fallbacks bounded-walk wording, and covers all three cases in tests. Then copy this record into Alfred docs/orchestration/maeve-lesson-batches/ with the required cejel_ filename prefix and that origin/main commit anchor.
